messages:
Jess (AE): Hey team — FinaraHealth agreed to an on-prem demo next week. They want a short validation run (2 nodes GPU, 1 control plane) and fallback to our hosted API if private path has issues. Need checklist: drivers, k8s, network, certs, and any gating security asks.
Ada (SE): Thanks. Quick Q: do they want GPU passthrough or dedicated GPU nodes?
Jess (AE): Dedicated GPU nodes. They also asked about pricing for a short Dedicated pool if we need to spin one.
Mike (Field Eng): Got it. For dedicated GPUs we need kernel >= 5.15, nvidia driver >= 525.xx for Hopper/Blackwell support, and CUDA >= 12.1. Also confirm NVLINK/IB if they use multi-GPU.
Ada (SE): Also need k8s version note — we officially support 1.26-1.28. Ask them to avoid 1.24/1.25.
Sam (Security): From Sec side: we need kubeconfig for operator bootstrap, an operator service account with limited NS scope (we provide exact policy), and outbound TLS egress to our fallback hostnames on 443. Also request: A written artefact that describes their CA rotation process and where certs are stored (KMS/HSM?).
Ralph (SRE): Add to network: allow DNS (UDP 53), NTP (udp/123) to upstream, and outbound to registry.redwood.ai:443 for images. If airgapped, we'll need image tarballs and manifest.
Mike (Field Eng): For quick verification run ask them to run these commands and paste outputs:
```
# on each node
nvidia-smi -L
nvidia-smi -a | head -n 80
cat /etc/os-release
kubectl get nodes -o wide
kubectl version --short
```
Ada (SE): We'll supply an operator image tag. If they can't pull, we can provide a signed tar.gz. For fallback to hosted API, I'll create a scoped API key labelled "finara-poc-fallback" that only allows inference and rate-limited.
Jess (AE): 👍 Please also confirm whether their infra team is okay with us creating a service account or if they prefer to create and give us a kubeconfig.
Sam (Security): If they want us to bring a kubeconfig, we need an expiration (24h max) and an allowlist of IPs. Otherwise they provide a SA with token and RBAC YAML. No cluster-admin please.
Mike (Field Eng): Edge note: some older drivers report weird CUDA allocation failures at 2k context size — ask them to run a small stress test: run a 2-worker LLM container (we'll send command) on each node and watch dmesg for OOM killer.
Ada (SE): I'll draft the quick-run playbook and the minimal RBAC. Also need to know whether their environment uses private DNS suffixes (split-horizon) since operator resolves internal registry names.
Jess (AE): I'll send them a one-pager with these asks and schedule a 1hr kickoff with infra + security. Does anyone want to join?
Ralph (SRE): I can join the kickoff for the first 30m to cover network egress and logging hooks.
Mike (Field Eng): I'll take the second half for driver/debug and node-level checks.
Sam (Security): I'll join to confirm SA policy and KMS expectations.
Ada (SE): I'll bring the operator RBAC and the fallback key details.
deploy-bot: deployment:create requested by Ada (SE) — created sandbox-fallback-key (scoped) — expires in 14 days.
Jess (AE): Thanks all. I'll draft and send the buyer email now and attach the checklist + the command snippets. Expect them to respond with outputs by EOD tomorrow. :rocket:
